characteristics.Description: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

(Once per battle, per unit) At the end of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select up to one friendly NECRONS INFANTRY/NECRONS MOUNTED unit within 6" of this unit. That unit resurrects: 
- When a unit resurrects, that unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate, but that unit heals D6 wounds (instead of D3 wounds). You cannot resurrect more than one unit per turn.
This unit’s ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1].
The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.
